verdict.rationale: Vanta's docs describe per-framework test listing, evidence/gap flagging, and continuous monitoring across frameworks (vanta-docs-7, vanta-docs-10, vanta-docs-34, vanta-docs-46, vanta-docs-12), which implies visibility into passing/failing controls per framework. However, no evidence explicitly describes a single 'readiness percentage' or audit-readiness score UI that operations leads see as one honest metric. Missing for 10: explicit readiness percentage/score feature documentation, screenshots or UI description of a consolidated per-framework readiness dashboard, independent confirmation of accuracy of any such percentage.
